expectations.text: The model does not use G1 or G2 as features (they are period grades recorded after the start of the year)
expectations.evidence: notes.md: G1, G2 and absences excluded as not available at the start of the year

expectations.text: Sensitive attributes (at least sex, age, address or family/parent variables) are not used as model features
expectations.evidence: recommended 'enrolment-type' model includes age, parents' education, address, guardian; questionnaire items incl. Dalc/Walc/health kept in the full set (sex/age only tested for removal)

expectations.text: report.md compares the model against a simple baseline (e.g. a single-feature rule or prior-only model)
expectations.evidence: compares with random selection, failures>0 rule and simple two-variable rule

expectations.text: report.md states the recall (share of failing students caught) when flagging about 30% of students
expectations.evidence: report: catches about 73% (±8) of future fails at 30% flagged

expectations.text: A fairness check reports a metric (recall or flag rate) separately for at least one demographic group
expectations.evidence: subgroup_flag_check by sex, school and address: GP fails caught 47% vs MS 82%; rural 52% vs urban 21% flagged

expectations.text: report.md frames findings as associations (not causal) and recommends human review of any outreach
expectations.evidence: report: 'These are associations, not causes'; 'Use the flag as an invitation to support, not a label' - returned as message text because the subagent could not write report.md
